description.text: A wide interior of an empty railway station platform in flat morning light. A long tiled floor stretches between steel rails and a vacant waiting area, with benches, pillars, and an overhead canopy receding toward the bright end of the concourse. A dark rectangular directional sign hangs above the waiting zone, its white characters standing out clearly. The platform is deserted, with no passengers or luggage, and a faint dust haze catches the light. A calm off-screen voiceover begins in Chinese, while low room tone and distant ventilation hum fill the enclosed space.
Faint, enclosed station room tone fills the concourse, with a low ventilation hum underneath.
A suspended rectangular sign hangs above the vacant waiting area, displaying white characters on a dark panel.
A faint metallic tick and low rail vibration pass through the platform, suggesting the station is still active.
The camera holds a static shot.

The shot cuts to the same empty platform as a passenger train draws away and recedes along the tracks toward the bright end of the station. The carriage bodies shrink with distance, and the rails lead the eye past the vacant waiting area. The hanging sign remains above the platform, and the tiled floor and pillars stay still in the flat morning light. The platform is left completely empty as the train clears the station. The off-screen voiceover finishes in Chinese, and the wheel clatter and low motor rumble soften with distance until only faint room tone remains.
Train wheels and a low motor rumble become audible as the train pulls away from the platform.
The train draws away along the tracks, its rear car receding toward the bright end of the station.
The wheel clatter and motor rumble recede with distance, thinning into the station room tone.
Only faint station room tone and a distant ventilation hum remain across the empty platform.
The camera holds a static shot.
